name: pack-s-mux-0200
comment: Fable's profile S (streams-cost report 2026-10-24, section 4.1), 200 projects on one launch cell, each waiting through ONE multiplexed wait (layout 6A package 2, POST /v1/projects/{p}/live:wait): 20 streams of 1 KiB JSON singles at 2 appends a second (open-loop Poisson), a tail on every stream and one consumer group (pull max 10, settle each) on 5 of the streams, which take a quarter of the appends, all in the `mux` phase: 1 parked wait a project where pack-s-NNNN holds 25. Otherwise pack-s-0046's: creates 0.1 s apart, setup 0-120 s, the load 180-1,640 s (projects start spread over 60 s), the verdict window 'steady' 360-1,560 s. The class pool holds every project's wait, appends and settles at once.
